name: Ridge Trail
description:
Enjoy the freedom of being in the outdoors, away from the noise and traffic of the city. Take a ride on the Ridge Trail through the villages and farmlands off Chikka Tirupati road near Gunjur. As the name suggests, this easy route of 25km on mostly flat terrain, will take you over several lake bunds and ridges, offering scenic views of the countryside. This ride is ideal for beginners and those looking to get back in the saddle after a long break. Also, if you're new to our weekend rides, this ride is exactly what you need.

description:
If you've ever been stranded on the road with a breakdown, you'll know the importance of bike maintenance. Even if you're new to cycling, this is essential know-how that will only make your journey into the world of bicycles even more fascinating. So come on over to our workshop and leave with some essential skills. You bring your own bike and we'll provide the tools. If you don't have a bike, just show up and we'll get you some hands-on on one of our bikes.
